titolo: Alaska Is Hiding Something Most Americans Never Notice

scene.testo: Alaska is so big that Texas would fit inside it twice.
Yet most Americans have never seen what hides here.
Stay with me, because the explanation is stranger than the size.
This state has more coastline than all other states combined.
Tens of thousands of miles, carved by ice and sea.
But that's not the strangest part.
Alaska has more than three million lakes.
Many are so remote that they have never been named.
Some are so quiet you only hear wind over the water.
In summer, the sun barely sets in the far north.
In Utqiagvik, it stays above the horizon for about eighty days.
Then winter arrives, and the sun vanishes for weeks.
The night sky then fills with shimmering green aurora.
Green ribbons ripple above frozen spruce trees and silent snow.
Alaska also holds North America's tallest mountain, Denali.
It rises about twenty thousand three hundred feet above sea level.
But the next secret is hidden underground.
